source.title: Hardening Information — Implementing a Zero Trust Architecture
source.applicability: Security configuration standards including DISA STIGs for infrastructure hardening, relevant to device encryption and endpoint security configurations

passages.text: Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) are security configuration standards from the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA). They contain technical guidelines on how to harden information systems.
